job.job_description:
Role: AI Python Automation Engineer (GEN AI)

Location: Gurugram (Hybrid)

Experience: 4+ Years

Employment Type: Full-Time




Mandatory Skills

Python
AI Automation
Generative AI (LLMs)
LangChain / LangGraph
SQL
Workflow Orchestration



Role & Responsibilities

Design and develop AI-powered automation solutions using Python and Generative AI technologies.
Build intelligent workflows using LLMs, AI Agents, LangChain/LangGraph, and prompt engineering.
Integrate AI applications with APIs, databases, and enterprise systems.
Develop scalable backend services, automation scripts, and AI pipelines.
Optimize AI workflows for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to automate business processes using AI.



Required Skills

4+ years of experience in Python development and automation.
Hands-on experience with LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or similar).
Strong knowledge of LangChain, LangGraph, AI Agents, and RAG.
Experience with REST APIs, SQL, Git, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP).
Good understanding of prompt engineering, vector databases, and AI workflow orchestration.



Good to Have

CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar Agentic AI frameworks.
FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes.
CI/CD and MLOps exposure.
Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), AI tool calling, and workflow automation.
